name: cannibal.r008_fire_signal_roof_lifecycle_mcw
description: Cannibal-policy member of the outcome-sized roof-fire family. The footprint conversion and fire materials are setup only; the worker must bind production-created cannibal actors and their actual signal, stalking, attack, bubble, return, and persistence path.

input: ordinary fire setup, native save-and-quit, and worker-owned live cockpit

steps.label: observe_cannibal_roof_fire_lifecycle
steps.objective: Create and receipt the normal player fire, retreat exactly two ordinary tiles, then identify whether production-created cannibals actually observe a source-backed signal and transfer to local ownership. Finish only after that local crossing is observed so the scenario can perform its native persistence boundary; preserve a quiet or confounded route as inconclusive.
proof_targets: normal fire and exact two-tile retreat
production-created cannibal identity and true signal channel
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen waits
invariants: fixture footprint conversion is zero credit
no hostile teleport or fabricated knowledge
one divergence does not erase unrelated observations

steps.label: open_native_full_save_after_cannibal_local_contact
steps.abort_reason: the cannibal local-contact route could not reach the native Save-and-Quit confirmation

steps.label: open_native_main_menu_quit_confirmation_after_cannibal_local_contact_save
steps.abort_reason: the completed native save did not return to an authoritative main-menu quit confirmation

steps.label: confirm_native_process_exit_after_cannibal_local_contact_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native process exits after the local crossing before the same world is reloaded

steps.label: post_cannibal_local_contact_save_reload_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same native save reloads into ordinary gameplay before the persisted return watch
steps.abort_reason: the terminal native local-contact save did not reload into ordinary gameplay

steps.label: observe_persisted_cannibal_return_lifecycle
steps.objective: Continue only from the persisted production local handoff. Use current advertised primitive actions through the evidence-derived return horizon, observe the cannibal departure, local-to-abstract return, and normalized persisted state, then finish. Do not reuse a prior recipe or manually acknowledge persistence.
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen waits
invariants: the save/reload is the sole persistence acknowledgement
no actor, knowledge, dispatch, or contact fabrication
short absence alone is not failure

evidence_contract.claim: claim-scoped cannibal response, real persistence crossing, and normalized return from production-created actors
evidence_contract.failure_rule: The converted camp footprint, setup receipts, short silence, unexplained contact, or an unacknowledged in-memory crossing cannot prove cannibal ecology or its return lifecycle.
